# Melanie

- Friend of Caroline
- Mother with kids
- Works full-time alongside parenting

## Hobbies
- Painting — paints landscapes and still life, including sunflowers (as of 2023-08-25); creates nature-inspired paintings with her kids, including a sunset with palm tree (as of 2023-07-15)
- Uses painting as emotional expression and relaxation
- Uses pottery as emotional expression and relaxation
- Plays violin
- Runs and reads for self-care
- Has a dog named Luna, a cat named Oliver, and another cat named Bailey; they brighten up her day
- Enjoys outdoor family activities (hiking, picnics, camping)
- Pottery — joined a pottery class around 2023-07-02; took kids to pottery workshop on 2023-07-14; creates pieces like a black-and-white flower design bowl, a cup with a dog face, a colorful patterned bowl, and a purple bowl with floral patterns (as of 2023-08-25)

## Key Facts
- Volunteered at a homeless shelter with her family on 2023-08-24
- Ran a charity race for mental health on 2023-05-23
- Recently got new purple/pink running shoes; runs farther than before for stress relief and mental health
- Prioritizes self-care to better support her family
- Favorite childhood book: "Charlotte's Web" — appreciated its themes of friendship and compassion
- Went on a family camping trip in the forest around late June 2023; enjoys outdoor activities with family
- Has 2 younger kids who love nature
- Considers pottery a huge part of her life, not just a hobby
- Flowers were an important part of her wedding decor
- Married — marrying her partner was the best part of her wedding day
- Family has been supportive during her transition
- Creativity and family keep her at peace

## Relations
- Married; has husband and children
- Close friend of Caroline; they chat regularly about life updates
